about: Data manifest for the DrugOS repository. Every vendored file under data/ is pinned by sha256; scripts/release.py gates verifies each checksum and fails the release on any mismatch (tampering, silent edits, or accidental drift). Sources that are distributed as packages (ADMET-AI, RDKit, terbapy-style model weights) or are license-restricted bulk downloads are documented in data/README.md and fetched via package managers; they are never vendored here.

files.source: Original experimental/pharmacokinetic reference bands (CL, t1/2, Fa, fe, Vss) for the five benchmark compounds: Goodman & Gilman 13th ed.; host USPIs (Tylenol, Coumadin, Cipro, Versed, Tikosyn); Bergan 1986; Greenblatt 1984; Smith 1992; partition model Rodgers & Rowland 2006 / Ye et al. 2016. Full strings in validation/benchmarks/citations.py.
files.license: Published numeric ranges; cited academic use. No bulk redistribution of third-party text.

files.source: ChEMBL REST API (www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl, target CHEMBL240 hERG) IC50 rows for the five-benchmark molecules; dofetilide only has public hERG IC50 measurements. Regenerated reproducibly by scripts/data/fetch_chembl_herg.py.
files.license: ChEMBL data is CC0/public-domain summary; reprocessed numeric values presented here.

files.source: hERG Central dose-response corpus (Du et al., J Chem Inf Model 2022), Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/7BVDG8 (datafile 5724875); provenance of the TDC 'Herg' benchmark; 306,893 PMID-anchored rows (X = %inhibition at 1 uM / 10 uM, binary hERG_inhib label).
files.license: Harvard Dataverse public dataset (CC0 public-domain release by authors).

files.source: O'Hara-Rudy 2011 human ventricular action-potential model (PLoS Comput Biol e1002061), Myokit .mmt encoding vendored from github.com/myokit/models (c/ohara-2011.mmt); BSD 3-Clause (Myokit). Validation case R-3 drives this model via the drugos.organ.cardiac_ap lane.
files.license: BSD 3-Clause (Myokit); model equations from the CC-BY open-access PLoS publication.

files.source: ORd-CiPA-v1 (2017) retune (Dutta, Chang, et al., Front Physiol 2017; official CiPA in-silico model), Myokit .mmt encoding vendored from github.com/myokit/models (c/ohara-cipa-v1-2017.mmt). Reserved for the multi-ionic-block upgrade path (doc/12).
files.license: BSD 3-Clause (Myokit); equations from the CC-BY open-access Frontiers publication.

files.source: Huang & Ferrell 1996 ultrasensitive MAPK cascade in SBML L2V4 (BioModels BIOMD0000000009, CC0), vendored for the Stage-3 pathway lane (doc/12 row 3). Parsed by python-libsbml via drugos.pathway.sbml_pathway; the pipeline default signal lane drives this model (readout PP_K = doubly-phosphorylated ERK).

Representative BSEP (ABCB11) efflux-inhibition IC50 anchors (SHH assay, uM) driving the R-7 cholestasis case and the organ cholestasis lane: transcribed from the open-access de Bruijn & Rietjens 2024 paper (Arch. Toxicol. 98:3077-3095, doi:10.1007/s00204-024-03775-6, CC BY 4.0); underlying measurements in the primary BSEP literature (Morgan 2010; Marchant 2019). Note: the companion model repository (github.com/Veronique-de-Bruijn/PBK-model-cholestasis) is licensed CC-BY-NC-ND and its code is intentionally NOT vendored or ported; only the paper's open-access equations and these published numeric anchors are used.
files.license: CC BY 4.0 (paper); small transcribed numeric table, no code. Data file created for this repository.

files.source: Rohwer, Meadow, Roseman, Westerhoff & Postma E. coli PEP:glucose phosphotransferase system in SBML L2V4 (BioModels BIOMD0000000038, CC0), vendored as the non-MAPK pathway scaffold for the SBML equivalence gate (L18). Parsed by python-libsbml via drugos.pathway.sbml_pathway with input_species='PEP' (energy-donor substrate, Glc is consumed at equilibrium) and readout 'Pyr'.

ChEMBL REST API measured (relation '=') IC50/Ki bioactivity snapshot for the general off-target DTI resolver (drugos/target/dti.py): 16 curated targets (hERG, CYP2D6/3A4/2C9, BSEP/ABCB11, OATP1B1, P-gp/ABCB1, glucocorticoid/estrogen/androgen receptors, mitochondrial complex I, and the CNS-liability set DRD2/CHRM1/ADRA1A/OPRM1/HRH1), geomean-central per canonical SMILES, potency-stratified and size-capped (3035 rows). Regenerated reproducibly by scripts/data/fetch_chembl_offtarget.py.
